Chunk EOF/offset/hash/byte limits and saved-page resume match docs; JSONL LF preservation matches docs; alert collector handles overlap/progress/changed rows. Caller total post-check missing in two exporter lanes, separate finding EC-01.

findings.requirement: operational-readback.md Stable reading: stop producers, settle passive and check native alert total before/after export

findings.effect: If alert total grows while reading a complete original prefix, exporter can declare old-total collection complete; no runtime count drift was observed in this audit.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep owned terminal/passive conditions and compare final numberOfAlerts to initial expected count, preferably through shared reviewed collector; preserve partial output on drift.
